messages.author: ca3205004f4bea24
messages.subject: Re: Upload video on facebook, twitter using R programming
parts:
You probably don't want to upload a video just yet - Twitter has a new
video capability that's coming soon, although there are mostly rumors
still.

The easy way right now is to just post a link to the video in a tweet.
YouTube links currently play and others may as well. The hard (but
better) way is to apply for the capability of posting video Twitter
Player Cards (https://dev.twitter.com/cards/types/player).

Images are easy - you can add an image to a Twitter Summary Card or
just post one in a tweet.
